questions.question: Dr. Imad, now a national ethics reference, is invited to an international congress. What message should he carry?
options: Ethics is an art in service of the patient relationship
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Ethics is an art in service of the patient relationship, combining integrity and humanity.' Dr. Soundous: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create a foundation to promote dental ethics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Promoting ethics and deontology is essential for the future of the profession.' Dr. Imad: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must write a reference book on dental ethics. What is the central message?
options: Ethics is an art that combines integrity, humanity, and rigor
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Ethics is an art that combines integrity, humanity, and rigor.' Dr. Soundous: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should she leave?
options: Ethics is evolving, full of opportunities
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Ethics is evolving, and opportunities are numerous for those who engage.' Dr. Imad: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must create a mentoring program in ethics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental ethical values.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must manage the succession of her ethical practice. What is the best strategy?
options: Gradually prepare the transmission of ethical values
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Gradual preparation of the transmission of ethical values is the key to a successful succession.' Dr. Imad: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must create an ethical charter for dental practices. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Integrity and patient trust are the pillars of any ethical charter.' Dr. Soundous: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must train future ethics mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of ethical values
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of ethical values.' Dr. Imad: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must prepare a testimony on his ethical journey. What is the most striking element?
options: Human encounters that shaped his ethical values
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Human encounters are the most striking moments of a professional life.' Dr. Soundous: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create an alumni association in ethics. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the link and foster mutual support in ethics
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Mutual support and the link are the driving forces of an alumni association in ethics.' Dr. Imad: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must write an article on the future of dental ethics. What trend should be highlighted?
options: Ethical innovation in service of the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Ethical innovation must serve the patient.' Dr. Soundous: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create an ethical quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Integrity, transparency, and patient trust are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Imad: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should he leave?
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The profession needs ethics enthusiasts.' Dr. Soundous: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create an award for young dentists in ethics. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Excellence in ethics is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' Dr. Imad: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must write his memoirs. What is the common thread to highlight?
options: The passion for ethics and encounters with patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The passion for ethics and encounters with patients are the common thread of a professional life.' Dr. Soundous: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create an ethics training center. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Training must produce ethics professionals.' Dr. Imad: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Ethical values and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Ethical values and the example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave.' Dr. Soundous: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must write a letter to future dentists about ethics. What message should she convey?
options: Ethics is an exciting and promising discipline
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Ethics is an exciting and promising discipline.' Dr. Imad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must create a scholarship for ethics students. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Supporting deserving students is an investment for the future of ethics.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must give a closing speech. What note should she leave?
options: Ethics continues to evolve with those who carry it
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Ethics continues to evolve thanks to those who carry it.' Dr. Imad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must transfer his ethical practice. What is the priority?
options: Transfer in the continuity of ethical values
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Transfer in the continuity of ethical values is the most beautiful success.' Dr. Soundous: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create a peer network for young dentists in ethics. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and sharing of ethical experiences
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young dentists in ethics.' Dr. Imad: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must write a conclusion to his book. What is the final sentence?
options: Ethics is a magnificent human adventure
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Ethics is a magnificent human adventure.' Dr. Soundous: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must leave a message to future generations. What is the message?
options: Ethics is a discipline worth experiencing
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Ethics is a discipline worth experiencing.' Dr. Imad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad, after a life dedicated to ethics, receives national recognition. Dr. Soundous is by his side. What is Dr. Imad's message to young dentists?
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad concludes: 'Ethics needs passion and dedication to continue evolving.' Dr. Soundous: 'I am proud of you.'
